chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Aban, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about decorating the sacrificial animal and yoking it, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'It does not matter which of those you do.' And I asked him about marking the sacrificial animal, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes, from the right side.' So I said, 'When should we mark it?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'When you intend to enter the state of Ihram.'

key_terms.تَجْلِيلِ الْهَدْيِ: Decorating or adorning the sacrificial animal
key_terms.تُحْرِمَ: To enter the state of Ihram (ritual consecration)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended methods and timing for marking and preparing a sacrificial animal for Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the practicalities of preparing a sacrificial animal (Hady) for Hajj or Umrah, emphasizing flexibility in decoration (Tajlil) and yoking (Taqlid) while specifying that marking (Ish'ar) must be performed on the right side. The timing for this marking is linked to the intention of entering Ihram, reflecting the Shia scholarly view that ritual preparation aligns closely with the spiritual commitment of the pilgrim. This guidance underscores the balance between ritual precision and ease in the performance of Hajj duties.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Al Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban, from Muhammad Al Halby who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about decorating the sacrificial animal and yoking it, so heasws said: ‘It does not matter which of that you do’. And I asked himasws about marking the sacrificial animal, so heasws said: ‘Yes, notch on the right side’. So I said, ‘When should we mark it’. Heasws said: ‘When you intend to wear the Ihraam’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Aban from Muhammad al-Halabiy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the decorating and placing something around the neck of the offering animal. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not important whichever you did.’ I asked about marking the offering animal. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, mark it on its right side.’ I asked, ‘When should I do it?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Do it when you want to assume the state of Hiram.”’
